Founder real-time: 'i just added universal animation library 1...' then 'GEORGE LEELA MIKE AND STAN ARE ANIMATED ROBOT CHARACTERS WITH MESH RIG AND ANIMATIONS PER BOT'. Vendored GOLDENBAND's multi-kit gband_skel_npc, exported+validated real assets from IDUNA nock_animations (Stan=43/Mike=43/Leela=17/George=47 joints), wired all 5 kits into gband_shader_and_mesh_init, bumped VBO capacity 20000->30000 for George's 23592-vert mesh, rewrote draw_player_skin_mannequin for p->id-based kit selection (honestly not yet AIRole-aware, named as follow-up). make lobby clean, Xvfb smoke test no-crash over 8s (new code path unreachable in this sandbox's no-GL-driver environment, a pre-existing limitation, not a regression). Commits: 66b9ae3, 30f0ef2, 1c498eb, 9c9fead.
